name: Knowii: Complete Knowledge System & Community
contents: **Flagship Offer**: Everything keeps growing; join now, get everything added later
**All Tiers**: Private community, live events, expert access, monthly challenges, 2K+ concept knowledge base, [~10K published notes](https://notes.dsebastien.net/)
**Knowledge Builder**: Access to premium spaces + Regular Workshops & Deep Dives
**Knowledge Master**: Access to ALL past & future courses, products and tools, exclusive events (e.g., AMAs, group coaching, masterminds, etc) . Best value for serious knowledge workers

variants.name: Explorer
variants.description: Community discussions, PKM guidance & tutorials, curated content, resource library, templates, community support. **Free bonuses:** 2K+ concepts Knowledge Base, [Knowledge System Checklist](/product/knowledge-system-checklist), PKM Tools Database.

variants.name: Knowledge Builder
variants.description: Everything from Explorer, plus: [Premium Workshops](/categories/workshops), [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) & [Course](/product/obsidian-starter-course), Expert Access, Monthly Challenges, Newsletter Archives, Early Access. **$150+ value included!**

variants.name: Knowledge Master
variants.description: Everything in Knowledge Builder, PLUS: Exclusive events (AMAs, group coaching, masterminds), **All Courses** ([KM for Beginners](/product/knowledge-management-for-beginners), [Obsidian Course](/product/obsidian-starter-course) + future), **All Tools** ([Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit), [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit), [PKM Library](/product/pkm-library), [AI Ghostwriter Guide](/product/ai-ghostwriter-guide) + future), Implementation Support, Experimental Content. **~$500 value included!**
